items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: And Danny said, man, I need a bass player, you know. And Ernest Hollins told him, so why not get Curtis, man. See, I was the last one in Danny's band.

ctx.x: You teach yourself, you teach yourself wrong sometimes.

Yeah, yeah. And how I started playing with Danny White, see, Danny White had a band, and they had Irvin Bannister, Ernest Hollins, Hulk, Henry Hawkins, the trumpet player. Henry Hawkins, yeah, Hawkins. Yeah, yeah. And Irvin Bannister and Joe Fox in the band, you know. And so he got this job on St. Charles Avenue with the club Sands, you know.
